commit.message:
test: strengthen seven remaining vacuous regression sites (#7928) (#7930)

* test(cli): make the gym clash channel test able to see a zero-clash detector (#7925)

The totalClashes >= 0 assertion held for any count, and the score check
compares the score against a function of the same count, so a detector that
reported zero clashes passed. Add a seeded-episode test that requires a
positive count and a score below 1.

* test(mcp): assert the model_audit score is the mean of its categories (#7925)

A range check on overall passes for a constant 0. Assert the duplicate
count, the identity score and that overall is the rounded mean of the three
category scores.

* test(provenance): recompute the merge battery false-conflict rate from its counts (#7925)

A [0,1] range check passes for a constant 0. Recompute the rate from the
false-conflict and auto-merge counts and check the kill-criterion flag
against it.

* test(clash): check the named triangles contain their witness points (#7925)

Range checks on the triangle indices pass for a constant 0 or for the two
indices swapped. Require each named triangle to contain its witness point,
with each mesh being the large one once so the index is unambiguous.

* test(lists): guard the all-null row checks against an empty result (#7925)

Four tests asserted rows.every(v === null) with no row count, so an engine
that returned no rows satisfied them. Assert the expected row count first.

* test(export): require the rebar fabrication checks to exist before asserting none passed (#7925)

Both all(Uncheckable) assertions were satisfied by an empty check list, so a
precheck that silently dropped every requested check still passed. Assert
the sweeps are present and that each requested check kind is reported.

* test(collab): pin fnv1a to the canonical 32-bit vectors (#7925)

The color helper promises the same color for the same id across machines,
but its only hash test checked the output range, and the determinism check
passes for any constants. Changing the offset basis or the prime left the
whole collab suite green. Add the published FNV-1a reference vectors.

* test(cli): gym test comment gives the AB22 clash count's real history, not 19 -> 75

---------

Co-authored-by: Petru Conduraru <petru@bimvoice.com>
